about:
S N Steel Fabrication operates from Ogden, Utah, in the northern part of the state. The company does business as SN Steel and focuses on steel fabrication for multi-family commercial housing projects. No founding year or ownership details are disclosed in public sources.

The shop provides commercial metal fabrication services, producing steel components for both residential and commercial building industries. Its work spans structural and architectural steel for apartment complexes and other multi-unit housing. Facility size, headcount, and annual volume are not published.

Customers come from the residential and commercial construction sectors, with a stated emphasis on multi-family housing developers and general contractors. The company does not name specific clients or projects in its public materials.

SN Steel describes itself as a high-end fabrication operation and states that its team is committed to meeting customer specifications. No further differentiation or origin story is provided.
